description: Call before adding a dependency: check SPDX licences or packages against your project licence and use, with a compatibility verdict per item.

items.description: Up to 20 items: an SPDX licence expression (MIT, GPL-2.0-or-later, MIT OR Apache-2.0) or a package with its declared licence; a package with no licence is unknown

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem, e.g. npm or pypi

license.description: SPDX licence expression the package declares, e.g. MIT or (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0)

project_license.description: Your project's licence: one SPDX id (Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only) or proprietary; default proprietary

use.description: How you ship it: distribute (default), saas (network use only) or internal

name: stackfacts_license_check
